prerequisites: The student has already followed first semester courses in phase 1 or a comparable education.

learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to formulate a clear problem statement, objective, and assignment for electronic or ICT systems in consultation with stakeholders.
He/she substantiates the assignment through analysis and research.
The student is able to develop an electronic or ICT system for a proof of concept or service that meets a number of conditions.
He/she is able to realize a relevant implementation within the set conditions. He/she justifies the choices made for the different components.
The student delivers a working proof of concept solution or service.
The solution is a complete and correct implementation of established requirements. He/she verifies and validates the product or service against the established requirements.
The student makes technological system function in its application context or work environment.
He/she compiles a documentation bundle with a view to reproducing and maintaining it.
The student communicates purposefully about the assignment using the main current communication forms and techniques.
He/she is able to clearly summarize the different aspects of his project, express them orally and in writing, and present them visually.
The student can offer relevant advice to third parties in relation to his/her design and the associated process. This for a wide variety of stakeholders and possible target groups.
The student has insight into his/her own entrepreneurial ability.
He/she demonstrates an entrepreneurial attitude including initiative, out-of-the-box thinking, perseverance, design thinking, critical thinking, self-knowledge, and action orientation.
He/she takes into account the commercial feasibility of his project.
The student strives for quality work in terms of project and performance management. He/she performs his/her own tasks as independently as possible and works in a solution-oriented manner.
He/she steers, evaluates, and optimizes his/her own effectiveness. He/she adjusts based on feedback.
He/she approaches assignments in a project-based manner and respects the planning and budgetary context, adjusting if necessary.

He/she functions in a team-oriented and entrepreneurial manner. The student adopts a constructive attitude as an expert member of a (project) team with a view to his/her own (future) role and responsibility within a company or organization. He/she thinks in an international and digital working environment.

syllabus_topics: Project-dependent and multidisciplinary content, with aspects aligning with various course components of the program.
Project proposal approval by the supervising lecturer.
Presentation and defense of project results.
assessment_rules: The overall assessment is on a 1-20 point scale. Re-examination will follow the same format as the first examination. There are no partial transfers for this course unit.
